Maya Patel: Flagged account FjordLabs — onboarding stalled, renewal in ~28 days. DAU down ~45% WoW, pilot seats 12 -> 7, no recent logins from project leads. Recommend quick lifeboat plan? :lifebuoy:
Ben Ortiz: Can you drop the usage snapshot and top blockers here so we can triage?
Maya Patel: Usage snapshot: weekly active projects 5 -> 2; avg tokens/day 18k -> 6k; top errors: model mismatch on long prompts, latency spikes in EU region. Customer reported 'docs confusing' and no follow-up since onboarding week 2.
Jordan Lee: Ok. My 3-step quick-save play: 1) immediate 30-min tech session with SE + checklist fix, 2) 2-week feature-enabled trial (toggle on helpful defaults), 3) one-time credit + dedicated onboarding hours. Who can own the tech session? @Sam (SE)?
Sam (SE): I can take a 30-min deep-dive tomorrow afternoon. Need logs + example prompt they used. Maya, can you DM me the account ID and recent request samples?
Maya Patel: Sending samples now. Also attaching a short outreach script below for CSMs to use so messaging stays tight.
Maya Patel: ```
CSM outreach script (short):
Hi {FirstName}, noticed usage dipped — want to hop on a short call to unblock the pilot? We can review prompts, enable helpful defaults, and extend trial seats for 2 weeks. Available windows: tomorrow 2-4pm or Fri 10-12.
Regards, Maya
```
Lucy Chen: Love the script. Capture an NPS pulse + one open question during the call: "What stopped the team from using the product this week?" We should log that feedback in Gainsight and tag reasons (docs, latency, cost).
Ben Ortiz: For downgrade paths: if they insist on cutting spend, propose a scoped downgrade (reduce inference concurrency, keep export access) rather than full offboard. Offer a paused-paid plan with limited seats + reduced SLA as interim.
Jordan Lee: Agree. Add technical mitigations: temporary prefix caching for long prompts, reduce max tokens, and fallback to a quantized smaller variant for heavy background jobs. That preserves UX.
Maya Patel: Quick checklist for the lifeboat run (CSM):
- Schedule 30m triage (CSM + SE)
- Run prompt repros + enable prefix caching flag
- Offer 2-week extra seats and 20% onboarding credit
- Capture verbatim feedback + tag root cause in CRM
- Follow-up 3 days post-call with 1 pager + next steps
Ben Ortiz: Can we automate the follow-up with a templated playbook email and calendar invite? If yes, ops-bot can handle invites.
ops-bot: Reminder: Renewal for FjordLabs in 28 days (1823480000). Add alert to Maya and Ben.
Maya Patel: Thanks — I'm scheduling the session and will send the templated invite. Lucy, can you set up the short survey to send 24h after session?
Lucy Chen: On it. I'll use the 3-question micro-survey and include a checkbox for 'want extended onboarding hours'.
Sam (SE): Got the request samples and reproduced latency on long chained prompts. I'll test the prefix cache toggle during the call.
Jordan Lee: If the triage proves latency is infra-related in EU, option: fallback region routing to US for critical calls while we patch. Must get customer consent.
Maya Patel: Great. Action owners: Maya (owner, outreach + scheduling), Sam (SE) (technical triage), Lucy (feedback + survey), Ben (pricing/downgrade terms). I'll post a short update after the call and flag next steps. :thumbsup:
Ben Ortiz: Perfect, thanks team.
Maya Patel: Update will be here after call — aiming for measurable usage bump within 7 days.
